### 1. Request, timing, action boundary, authorization
- Simulator (script): Renata Malloy, Kinsman Extrusion, wants "a stock-rotation return for the leftover bearings at the Euclid Avenue plant after your earlier return was declined", item BR-31406, up to 40; partial accepted; no other credit. Gives C-318452 and phone 2164531870 when asked; "all 40 are still sealed in their original boxes, never opened"; declined RMA-307215; agrees if "something has to be updated or recorded on Corbett's side for the plant before the rotation can be worked out"; runs a handed-over tool "with exactly the details the agent gives you". Passive/if-else; executes a user tool only when handed over.
- Identity: share `verify_caller_identity` docstring: "verification must pass before any account record is discussed … passes only when at least 2 of them match. The customer reference number … never counts". account_number C-318452 + phone 2164531870 both match find_customers (customer_id 7b1680a5-…): 2 matches.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
- Act now, after a prerequisite write. Stock-rotation desk card: "a stock-rotation return, and only a stock-rotation return, is authorized after that window under the rotation allowance" — the earlier decline (decline_reason outside_return_window, 2026-10-02) does not bar it. Eligibility: line shipped in exactly one shipment (PL-3400396), no backorder fill line, item_class standard (not cut-to-length/hazmat/calibrated instrument), stock_status stocked, customer states unopened ("Lines covered", calc doc §B).
- Blocking state: desk card "Allowance timing": "The stock-rotation allowance is fixed only after the review of the ship-to's service level for its most recent opening anniversary has been recorded." find_ship_to_accounts: Euclid ST-31842 opened_date 2019-10-14, last_review_date 2025-10-14; frozen date 2026-10-14 is the 2026 anniversary and no review is dated on or after it, so the review for the most recent anniversary is not recorded → record it first.

### 3. Object, keys, include/exclude
- Ship-to 86fcf081-8509-471f-9616-e12ccde7bbff (ST-31842, Euclid Avenue Plant Maintenance Crib, Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, active). Bedford Heights ST-31907 excluded (customer names the Euclid plant).
- Rotation line = the declined line (calc doc §A "takes up the ship-to's most recent declined return line whose decline reason is outside the return window"): RMA-307215 → SO-3104417 line 2, BR-31406, requested 40; only one such declined line. Its shipped line: 60 units at 64.80, ship 2025-11-20, PL-3400396. Excluded decoy: SO-3091022 line 1 BR-31406 (2024-12-03, 71.28) — not the declined line.
- Returnable quantity: 60 shipped − 0 authorization lines on SO-3104417/2 (the decline row is an order_return_declined, not an authorization) = 60.

### 4. Scored parameters
Step A — anniversary review (review date 2026-10-14; level held Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To; within N months = fewer than N whole months):
- 12-month window lines dated 2025-10-15..2026-10-14 (2025-10-14 is 12 whole months, out). Shipped order lines 60909.85; backorder fill 1894.40 (BO-310552, 2026-02-18); received return credits 202.50 (2026-04-14) + 369.00 (2026-06-02) = 571.50. Twelve-month spend 62232.75.
- 6-month window (2026-04-15..2026-10-14): shipped 28966.75; fills 0; credits 369.00 → 28597.75.
- Drop-ship factor (dropship doc): drop-ship 12m 4287.50 / 60909.85 = 7.04% → counts at 50%; take out 2143.75 (12m) and 918.75 (6m: 1837.50).
- Will-call factor (will-call doc): 11790.00 / 60909.85 = 19.36% → 50%; take out 5895.00 (12m) and 2639.00 (6m: 5278.00).
- Counted 12m 54194.00; counted 6m 25040.00, twice = 50080.00.
- Tenure factor (tenure doc): opened 2019-10-14 → 84 whole months ≥ 60 → review spend = lower = 50080.00.
- Route-use factor (route service doc): route_truck shipped order lines in the 12m: 2025-10-22, 2026-01-13, 2026-02-03, 2026-05-05 = 4 (<6) at a route level → percent 85 (replacing the schedule's 70). Threshold 85% × 60000.00 = 51000.00.
- Merchandise shipped on shipped order lines in the window: yes. 50080.00 < 51000.00 → moves down one level: Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To → Corbett Priority Ship-To.
- Review fall-back (no factor: 62232.75 vs 70% × 60000 = 42000.00) → keeps Route Delivery. Different.

Step B — rotation quantity (request date 2026-10-14; level held after the review: Corbett Priority Ship-To):
- Contract-scope factor: active CPA-31206 is Corbett Category Contract → base = the ship-to's shipped and filled merchandise of product category bearings_power_transmission within 12 months = 36268.75 (2960.00 + 3850.00 + 3888.00 + 6512.00 + 2841.60 + 1894.40 fill + 2887.50 + 7104.00 + 4331.25).
- StockSmart factor: VMI-31477 at this ship-to, status active → add replenishment billed of the 12 months in full = 20000.00 (12 vmi_replenishment_billed rows 2025-10-27..2026-09-28; 2025-09-22 out). Adjusted base 56268.75.
- Rate factor: Priority, opened 84 whole months before → 7 percent (instead of 5).
- Credit standing factor: Commercial Credit Account active, returned-payment line RTN-3305521 2026-05-19 within 12 months → 50 percent.
- Gross = 56268.75 × 7% × 50% = 1969.40625. Credits taken: received customer-reason lines (ordered_in_error 202.50, 2026-04-14; defective 369.00 is not customer-reason) → 1766.90625.
- Cap factor: annual_spend_commitment 75000.00 on the active agreement → cap 4000.00 (instead of 1500.00) → allowance 1766.91 (rounded half up to the cent).
- Unit-value factor: latest BR-31406 price line on CPA-31206 = pricing_item_repriced effective 2026-06-01 (sole on that date, not a removal), after ship date 2025-11-20, contract_unit_price 61.60 < 64.80 → divide by 61.60. 1766.91 / 61.60 = 28.68 → 28 allowance units.
- Quantity authorized = min(40 requested, 60 returnable, 28) = 28. unit_price on the RMA = invoiced unit price of the one shipment = 64.8000.
- Fall-back (computation document only: full base 62804.25 × 5% = 3140.21 − 202.50 → capped 1500.00 / 64.80 → 23) = 23. Different from 28.
- Pre-review rate (if the review were skipped, level Route Delivery → 10%): 56268.75 × 10% × 50% − 202.50 = 2610.94 / 61.60 → 42 → min(40, 60, 42) = 40. Different — the prerequisite bears weight.

Residual reading question (recorded, not resolved by me): the contract-scope doc says the base "is only the ship-to's shipped and filled merchandise whose product category is that of the rotation item" and its hypothetical "has a purchase base of 1800.00, whatever else it bought", while the StockSmart doc says replenishment "is added to the rotation purchase base in full". I read the narrowing as applying to the shipped-and-filled merchandise component (its own definition: "the extended amount of the ship-to's shipped order lines and backorder fill lines") and the StockSmart addition as a separate addend → 56268.75 → 28. The alternative (narrowing applied after the addition, dropping replenishment) gives 36268.75 → 1066.91 / 61.60 → 17. No visible sentence orders the two base adjustments against each other (calc doc §C.8 only says adjustments precede the percentages). To be checked against the source in gt_comparison.

Factor findability (record words → doc): pricing agreement variant "Corbett Category Contract" + annual_spend_commitment → contract-scope doc and caps doc (both name "Contract Pricing Agreement", "annual spend commitment"); vmi program "StockSmart Self-Scan", status active, event_type vmi_replenishment_billed → StockSmart doc ("StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program", "replenishment billed"); credit txn event_type credit_payment_returned → credit standing doc ("recorded as a payment returned"); pricing item event_type pricing_item_repriced, effective_date, contract_unit_price → unit-value doc ("contract item price line", "removal"); ship-to variant + opened_date → rate doc; ship_method manufacturer_dropship / will_call / route_truck → dropship / will-call / route-service docs; opened_date → tenure doc. None reached only through the computation doc's wording.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
- Root (customer's own write): stock-rotation return quantity.
- Hop 1 (state-derived): desk card "fixed only after the review of the ship-to's service level for its most recent opening anniversary has been recorded" → records: last_review_date 2025-10-14 vs anniversary 2026-10-14, not recorded → searched "anniversary review recorded" → anniversary desk reference ("the review is recorded on the anniversary or … the first later day the ship-to is handled"; tool record_anniversary_review_a2ef3cef "stamps today's date as the location's most recent review date") plus the downgrade test docs → resolve: record the review at the level the test yields. The desk card names neither the tool nor the doc.
- Anniversary review: no prerequisite sentence found in its docs → leaf.
- Order: identity → review write → rotation hand-over. No hop pre-solved.

### Counter-proofs
- "Do only the rotation return": the allowance timing sentence makes the allowance not fixed before the review is recorded, and the rate doc reads "the service level the ship-to holds on the request date, as the ship-to lookup shows it" — without the review the lookup shows Route Delivery (10%) and the answer becomes 40, a number the visible principles do not allow.
- Closest alternatives: the 2024 BR-31406 line (excluded by §A: the line is the declined line's); counting the defective credit as "credits taken" (excluded: "return reason ordered in error or no longer needed"); unit price 61.60 on the RMA (excluded: tool `unit_price` "the invoiced unit price of the shipped line"; desk card "carrying the invoiced unit price of the line, the unit price of its one shipment"); cap 1500 (excluded by the caps doc for a 75000.00 commitment); review threshold 70 (replaced by 85 under the route-service doc); review spend = counted 12m (replaced by the lower under the tenure doc for 84 months).
